name: F1-5HA
description: F1-5HA was an astromech droid who served the Resistance on the planet Ajan Kloss during the First Order-Resistance War. The droid was one of five astromechs who worked under R5-2JE and who were all absent from their jobs at the landing pad one day. F1-5HA was busy trying to fish a king-sized catch down by the river and refused to leave until the droid caught a large catch.
